## Seat ruling · #29166 item (2) · 2026-11-02T12:11Z

Ruling-ref: the dev's measurement and options in os-dev-report `6576781813` (open_questions[0] and [1]); the seat delta, which set item (2) as "build only if unambiguous, otherwise options A and B"; the maintainer's standing word that lane seats decide technical sequencing and grading (2026-11-01T12:11Z).

**Ruling: option B. The run-time failure is the answer; nothing new is declined at arming.**

- What was measured: a caller whose top-level subflow or map reaches a child that makes a region call to a suspending grandchild arms today. Without a fault edge its run fails loudly. With a fault edge on its subflow node it completes, because the child's region refusal reaches the caller as an ordinary child failure, and the subflow contract defines that as routable.
- Why B: the defect lives in the child, and the child's own arming gate names it as soon as the child has its own trigger. Declining the caller (A) would refuse flows that their authors routed and that complete today, a narrowing with no measured user asking for it. C changes routing that authors can see today. Neither is the unambiguous reading the delta required.
- What ships in PR #29329: item (1) as built, plus a docblock note in `subflow-region-guard.ts` and/or `region-suspension-refusal.ts` that records this reading. A child's region call fails the child; the caller meets an ordinary, routable child failure; the arming decline stays one level deep, by design. Comments only, `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`. With B, item (2) is answered, so the PR body moves from `Part of #29166` to `Fixes #29166`.
- If the maintainer later wants the child's refusal to stay un-routable one level up, that is option C on its own narrowing card, not a reopening of this one.

**open_questions[1] (partial chain): option A, a follow-up card.** When a deeper link's degrading read fails, `resolveSuspensionChain` stops early and the deeper run is not cancelled. This is the same defect class as item (1), one link deeper. The seat files it now; it is out of this PR.
